title: fix(test): worker containment checks expect retired recovery guidance
body:
Related: #194473, #196756

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes worker-runtime checks rejecting the current source-specific containment guidance and compact error-result text.

## User Impact

No production or permission changes. The fixture retains exact denial diagnostics, unchanged outside-file bytes and mode, and separation of operator-only hints from model-visible output.

## Why This Change Was Made

#194473 intentionally distinguishes configuration containment from a recorded session root: a hidden native child cannot widen the latter by changing cwd. #196756 intentionally emits compact model-visible JSON. Independently assert both current messages and compact serialization instead of restoring obsolete generic respawn advice. Existing policy, filesystem and logging assertions remain intact; no retries, timeouts, skips, baselines, production changes or net test growth.

Contributor credit: @steipete and @obviyus.

## Work sessions

Linked for team reference; these sessions aren’t public.

- [Discussion, implementation and verification](https://team.openclaw.ai/chat/roboclaw/~key/dashboard/b5679712-7777-4ff7-a05a-81c1efab2069)

## Evidence

- Scheduled run 42959288749, job 130322099305 identifies the two configured/guarded exact-message mismatches at `worker-runtime-permissions.suite.ts:303`.
- Source-extracted execution of the actual recovery-message owner against the independently written expectations fails both original cases and passes both candidate cases. This is diagnostic-boundary proof, not complete worker-runtime/filesystem integration proof.
- Touched-file formatting and `git diff --check` pass. Independent isolated Codex review through P2 completed scoped-clean, no findings.
- Named `src/worker/worker.runtime.test.ts` execution stopped before collection because this independent task checkout lacks dependencies. Full named execution and static checks remain for exact-head PR CI before landing; no guard was bypassed or local full-test pass claimed.
- No workflow dispatch, rerun, browser/container, broad local suite, dependency staging, production Gateway or credential change.

## Worked on by

- @obviyus
- @steipete
